personal.title: Dress-up selfie
personal.description: Get someone to wear one item of your clothing, then take a selfie with them showing it off. Proof: the selfie.

personal.title: Double fist bump
personal.description: Double fist bump a band member: both your fists against both of theirs. Proof: a photo, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: Tag rip
personal.description: Get someone to rip the tag out of your clothes. Proof: the tag, and who ripped it.

personal.title: Do me!
personal.description: Get a player to do an impression of you. Proof: who did it, and a player who saw it.

personal.title: Smashed screen
personal.description: Make your phone look broken (a cracked-screen wallpaper does the job) and get someone to comment on it. Proof: who fell for it and what they said.

personal.title: Wrong feet
personal.description: Put your shoes on the wrong feet and wear them like that for a whole set. Proof: a photo of your feet.

personal.title: Did you hear that?
personal.description: Pretend to hear a strange noise and get someone to agree they heard it too. Proof: who agreed, and what they think they heard.

personal.title: Timber!
personal.description: Fall over (gently, somewhere soft) and get someone to help you up. Proof: who picked you up.

personal.title: What time is it?
personal.description: Confidently get the time of day wrong and get someone to correct you. Proof: who corrected you, and the time you claimed it was.

personal.title: Back scratch
personal.description: Get someone to scratch your back. Proof: who did it.

personal.title: Secret tattoo
personal.description: Draw on a player without them noticing. It has to be bigger than a 2p coin (washable pen, nowhere rude). Proof: a photo of your artwork.

personal.title: Overcooked superfan
personal.description: Keep telling people how much you love Overcooked until another player agrees with you. Proof: which player agreed, and what they said.

personal.title: Sam Rhone lookalike
personal.description: Tell a stranger they look just like Sam Rhone and show them a picture to prove it. Proof: their reaction (a photo together if they're up for it).

personal.title: Heads up
personal.description: Balance an object on the heads of three players without them noticing. Proof: a photo of each one.

personal.title: Rock, paper, streak
personal.description: Win three games of rock paper scissors in a row. Proof: a player who saw the streak.

personal.title: Juggle for me
personal.description: Get someone to juggle three objects. Proof: a photo mid-juggle, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: Under the table
personal.description: Get a player to look under the table. Proof: which player looked, and what they thought was down there.

personal.title: Pocket pebbles
personal.description: Slip at least five pebbles into a player's pocket without them noticing. Proof: the player turning out their pocket.

personal.title: Autograph hunter
personal.description: Collect signatures from at least four band members (on a ticket, a beer mat, your arm). Bonus bragging rights for a phone number. Proof: the signatures, and whose they are.

personal.title: Say the word
personal.description: Get a player to say the word "spatula" without you saying it first. Proof: the player, and how you got them there.

personal.title: Look up
personal.description: Stare up at the ceiling (or the sky) until at least three people look up too. Proof: a photo of everyone looking up.

personal.title: Slow clap
personal.description: Start a slow clap between songs and get at least three people to join in. Proof: a player who heard it.

personal.title: Conga!
personal.description: Start a conga line of at least five people. Proof: a photo of the line.

personal.title: Mexican wave
personal.description: Get at least six people to join a Mexican wave that you started. Proof: a photo mid-wave, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: Very important call
personal.description: Take a fake phone call loud enough that a player asks who it was. Proof: which player asked, and who you said it was.

personal.title: Inside out
personal.description: Wear your top inside out until someone points it out. Proof: who noticed, and how long it took.

personal.title: New word
personal.description: Invent a word and keep using it until another player uses it too. Proof: the word, and who picked it up.

personal.title: Call me...
personal.description: Give yourself a nickname and get another player to call you by it, without asking them to. Proof: the nickname, and who used it.

personal.title: Little-known fact
personal.description: Make up a fact about Manchester and hear another player repeat it to someone else. Proof: the fact, and who passed it on.

personal.title: Not my birthday
personal.description: Get at least two people to sing Happy Birthday to you. It must not be your birthday. Proof: a player who heard it.

personal.title: You're right
personal.description: Get a player to say "you're right" to you three times in one night. Proof: the player, and what you were right about.

personal.title: Sorry, not sorry
personal.description: Get a player to apologise to you for something they didn't do. Proof: the player, and what they apologised for.

personal.title: Hold this
personal.description: Get someone to hold your drink for at least five minutes. Proof: a photo of them holding it.

personal.title: Lace me up
personal.description: Get someone to tie your shoelace for you. Proof: who tied it.

personal.title: Piggyback
personal.description: Get someone to give you a piggyback. Proof: a photo.

personal.title: Arm wrestle
personal.description: Arm wrestle a stranger, win or lose. Proof: a photo mid-match.

personal.title: Air guitar duel
personal.description: Challenge a stranger to an air guitar duel and see it through. Proof: a photo mid-duel, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: I'm with the band
personal.description: Convince a stranger that you play in one of the bands on tonight. Proof: which band you claimed, and how they took it.

personal.title: Alias
personal.description: Introduce yourself to a stranger with a fake name and get them to use it later in the conversation. Proof: the name, and a player who heard it.

personal.title: Shout-out
personal.description: Get a shout-out from the stage for you or the group (ask nicely, between songs). Proof: exactly what they said, and a player who heard it.

personal.title: My precious
personal.description: Take a pet from a bar (a spoon, a fork, a pint glass...) and keep it visibly on you for two bars. Proof: a photo of it at the first bar and at the last.

personal.title: You win some, you lose some
personal.description: Take a pint glass from one bar and leave it at another. Proof: a photo of the glass at the second bar.

personal.title: Worst gig ever
personal.description: Get a band member to tell you about their worst ever gig. Proof: the story, in one line.

personal.title: Rock face
personal.description: Take a selfie with a band member, both pulling your best rock face. Proof: the selfie.

personal.title: Shall we dance?
personal.description: Get a stranger to dance with you for a whole song (with their OK). Proof: a photo, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: Seat thief
personal.description: Take a player's seat when they get up, three times in one night. Proof: the player, and their face the third time.

personal.title: Earworm
personal.description: Hum a song until a player starts humming it too. Proof: the song, and the player.

personal.title: Question time
personal.description: Answer a player only with questions for five minutes without them calling it out. Proof: the player, who will vouch for it once they work it out.

personal.title: Pirate voice
personal.description: Hold a whole conversation with a stranger in your best pirate voice without breaking character. Proof: a player who heard it. Arr.

personal.title: Note on the back
personal.description: Stick a note on a player's back and leave it there for ten minutes without them noticing (keep it kind). Proof: a photo of the note in place.

personal.title: Where did it go?
personal.description: Hide something belonging to a player (not keys, phone or wallet) until they ask where it went, then give it back. Proof: the item, and the player who missed it.

personal.title: Snap me
personal.description: Get a player to take a photo of you without asking them to. Proof: the photo.

personal.title: Hand in hand
personal.description: Hold hands with a player for a whole song without explaining why. Proof: the player, and a photo if you can get one.

personal.title: New do
personal.description: Get someone to do your hair: a plait, a quiff, anything. Proof: a photo of the result.

personal.title: Write on me
personal.description: Get a stranger to write a message on your arm. Proof: a photo of the message.

personal.title: Cheers!
personal.description: Clink drinks with five different strangers (any drink counts). Proof: a photo of the fifth, or a player who counted.

personal.title: Across the room
personal.description: Get a stranger to give you a thumbs-up from across the room without saying a word. Proof: a photo, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: Secret handshake
personal.description: Invent a handshake with a stranger and do it together at least twice. Proof: a player who saw it.

personal.title: Treat me
personal.description: Get a player to buy you a drink or a snack without asking them directly. Proof: what you got, and who paid.

personal.title: Tell me a joke
personal.description: Get a band member to tell you a joke. Proof: the joke, word for word.

personal.title: Floor party
personal.description: Get at least two other people to sit on the floor with you. Proof: a photo.

personal.title: Swap shop
personal.description: Swap something small with a stranger (a badge, a pen, a sticker) and keep their thing with you all night. Proof: the item you got.

personal.title: Do the robot
personal.description: Get someone to do the robot. Proof: a photo mid-robot, or a player who saw it.

personal.title: Shades on
personal.description: Wear sunglasses indoors until someone asks why. Proof: who asked, and what you told them.

personal.title: Upside down
personal.description: Get someone to do a cartwheel or a handstand. Proof: a photo.

personal.title: Nice moves
personal.description: Get a stranger to compliment your dancing. Proof: what they said, and a player who saw it.

personal.title: High five run
personal.description: High five ten different people in under five minutes. Proof: a player who counted.

personal.title: Statue
personal.description: Freeze like a statue in a busy spot until someone asks if you're OK. Proof: who asked, and a player who saw it.

global.title: Trophy hunt
global.description: Get yourself a trophy: won, gifted or bartered, nothing nicked. Keep it with you until the end of the night; lose it and the GM docks you 10 points. Most unexpected trophy wins.

global.title: Off limits
global.description: Take a photo in the spot at the bar where you should least be (without getting thrown out). Most daring wins.

global.title: Hats only!
global.description: Find the least hat-like thing you can and wear it as a hat. Weirdest wins.

global.title: Album cover remake
global.description: Recreate a famous album cover with whatever (and whoever) is to hand. Name the album in your comment. Most faithful, or most ridiculous, wins.

global.title: Doug who?
global.description: Rename Douglas: funniest name wins. For the rest of the night, anyone who doesn't call Douglas by the new name loses 5 points (the GM docks them).

global.title: Pocket lottery
global.description: Show us the strangest thing you (or a willing friend) have in a pocket or bag right now. Strangest wins.

global.title: Human statue
global.description: Strike the most ridiculous frozen pose you can in public and hold it for the photo. Most commitment wins.

global.title: Doppelganger
global.description: Find a stranger who looks like one of the players and get a photo of the two side by side (with their OK). Closest match wins.

global.title: Power nap
global.description: Photograph a player pretending to be fast asleep in the least likely place. Most unlikely spot wins.

global.title: Fake moustache
global.description: Give yourself the finest fake moustache you can make from whatever is lying around. Most distinguished wins.

global.title: Outfit swap
global.description: Two players swap one item of clothing each. Show us the swap. Least flattering wins.

global.title: Squad face
global.description: Get as many people as you can into one photo, all pulling the same silly face (strangers welcome, with their OK). Most people wins.

global.title: Air solo
global.description: Show us you mid air-instrument solo: guitar, drums, triangle, commit to it. Most rock and roll wins.

global.title: Tiny giant
global.description: Use forced perspective to make something small look enormous, or someone look tiny. Best illusion wins.

global.title: Photobomb
global.description: Sneak into another player's photo without them noticing, then show us the result. Most outrageous bomb wins.

global.title: Napkin portrait
global.description: Get a stranger to draw your portrait on a napkin or a beer mat. Best (or worst) likeness wins.

global.title: Adopt an object
global.description: Give an object a face and a name, take it everywhere with you, and show us its best moment. Most loveable wins.

global.title: Twinning
global.description: Find a stranger dressed like you and get a photo together (with their OK). Closest match wins.

global.title: Accidental Renaissance
global.description: Stage a photo that looks like an old master's painting. Most dramatic wins.

global.title: Dance-floor disaster
global.description: Capture the most gloriously terrible dance move in your group. Most terrible wins.

story.title: Incriminating evidence
story.description: Catch another player in a compromising, incriminating moment, and tag who's in the photo. It stays open until the GM's deadline; the vote opens when new evidence is revealed.

story.title: Motive
story.description: You have been secretly given another player. Write why they killed Bob.

story.title: The good old days
story.description: A photo with your miniature Bob (everyone got one at the start of the night), capturing a fond memory with Bob.

story.title: Murder weapon
story.description: Find an object, photograph it and explain how it killed Bob. The most voted becomes the murder weapon.

story.title: Time of death
story.description: New evidence shows Bob was killed at 11:02 pm.

story.title: Couldn't be me
story.description: A video of someone, extra if they're a stranger, saying their name and backing your alibi for where you were at 11:02 pm.

story.title: The room where it happened
story.description: Photograph the place Bob was murdered and say why. The most voted becomes the scene of the crime.

story.title: New evidence is revealed!
story.description: The incriminating photos are out. Vote for the most damning.
